name: Ikuno Mio
source:
Grade: First Year
Affiliation: Rhythmic Gymnastics Fighting Club
Attributes: M-type, childhood friend
Problems: Boobs are too large for her weak back to carry.
Erogenous Zone(s): Nowhere in particular, but has a Shame-Blame fetish
Very docile and small in personality.
In order to overcome her shy nature, she asks Shunosuke to help her with training, as she feels like he's ashamed of her. 
She calls Shunosuke "coach", and being around him ignites a flame in her heart that makes her put 100% into training. 
As she grows more in love with Shunosuke, she wants their relationship to be more than a "student-teacher" one.
